definitionZh: 触摸动作CSS属性设定了一个元素的区域如何被触摸屏用户操纵(例如,通过放大浏览器中构建的特性).
sourceDefinition: The touch-action CSS property sets how an element's region can be manipulated by a touchscreen user (for example, by zooming features built into the browser).
